name: Scribe Pack
author: IdentityOS
description: Transforms an identity into a document intelligence specialist. Read, analyze, transform, and index files — your identity becomes a personal librarian and editor who knows every file in your project.

capabilities.reason: Navigate directories, read source files, inspect file metadata
Word counts, keyword extraction, pattern matching, text splitting
Document statistics, size calculations, readability metrics

example_uses: Read all the Python files in src/ and summarize their structure
How many lines of code are in this project?
Extract all TODO comments from the codebase
Read this file and give me a markdown summary
